title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Straight Bar | Antique Bronze | Allied Brass

Upgrade bathroom towel storage with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday use in Antique Bronze, which combines deep brown tones with subtle warm highlights, offering heritage appeal with modern durability. This straight-bar design is part of the Que New collection, created to coordinate with matching versatile bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware.
